title: Bus to China
text:
In Sary-Mogol we heard that it was possible to catch a weekly bus to Kashgar (in Xinjiang). So, we ended up ditching our plans to go to Uzbekistan.

On the Kyrgyz side, we drove past a ~40 km-long queue of trucks heading for the border. I’m surprised the drivers don’t get altitude sickness while stuck in bumper-to-bumper traffic on the 3800 m mountain pass.

The customs and immigration process was fairly intense, but when I showed the immigration officer my itinerary (translated into Mandarin using ChatGPT), he asked, “Did a guide plan this for you?” :).

All up, it took around 10 hours.
